purpose: Attack common-mode transcript, ordering, cardinality, closure, and open-universe bugs that a finite hand-written corpus could miss.

per_trial_properties.construction: Choose a nonempty subset of ALLOW for every world, preserving per-world consequential-cut totality.
Add one fresh target-native consequence to one admitted world and submit that pair as the grounded witness.
Submit the same target relation containing the fresh forbidden consequence as a preservation certificate.
Independently permute worlds, ALLOW, REALIZE, grounding entries, artifact worlds/possible rows, and evidence roots without changing semantic sets.
per_trial_properties.expected: Bound identities remain stable and W1=W2=ACCEPTED/PRESERVATION

success_rule: All 384 generated comparisons must match the declared oracle and W1/W2 must agree on process and semantic class for every comparison. The generator must import neither checker implementation.
